MODAL.TITLE: Whatsapp Templates
MODAL.SUBTITLE: Select the whatsapp template you want to send

PICKER.SELECT_LANGUAGE: Choose a language version before continuing.
PICKER.NO_TEMPLATES_AVAILABLE: No WhatsApp templates available. Click refresh to sync templates from WhatsApp.
PICKER.REFRESH_SUCCESS: Templates refresh initiated. It may take a couple of minutes to update.
PICKER.REFRESH_ERROR: Failed to refresh templates. Please try again.

PARSER.FORM_ERROR_MESSAGE: Please fill all variables before sending

MANAGEMENT.PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Create and manage WhatsApp Cloud templates for this channel. New templates are submitted to Meta for review and appear here as soon as the local cache updates.
MANAGEMENT.SUPPORTED_DESCRIPTION: This builder supports body text, text or media headers, footer text, quick reply buttons, URL buttons, copy code buttons, and phone number buttons.
MANAGEMENT.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search templates by name, status, language, or text
MANAGEMENT.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Create your first template or sync from WhatsApp to load the existing library.
MANAGEMENT.NO_RESULTS_DESCRIPTION: Try a different name, status, or text fragment.
MANAGEMENT.CREATE_DESCRIPTION: Build a supported WhatsApp Cloud template and send it to Meta for review.
MANAGEMENT.CREATE_SUCCESS: Template submitted to Meta for review.
MANAGEMENT.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: Delete template "{templateName}" from WhatsApp Cloud? This removes every language version that uses the same template name.
MANAGEMENT.VARIABLE_HINT: Use sequential variables like {firstVariable}, {secondVariable} when you need dynamic values.
MANAGEMENT.BUTTONS_HINT: You can add up to {count} supported buttons.
MANAGEMENT.NO_BUTTONS: Buttons are optional. Leave this empty for a simple text template.

FIELDS.HEADER_PLACEHOLDER: Your order {firstVariable} is on the way

ERRORS.NAME_FORMAT: Template name can only use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
ERRORS.BODY_VARIABLE_POSITION: Body text cannot start or end with a variable.
ERRORS.HEADER_VARIABLE_POSITION: Header text cannot start or end with a variable.
ERRORS.MEDIA_URL_REQUIRED: Sample media URL is required for media headers.
ERRORS.BUTTON_LIMIT: You can add up to {count} buttons.
ERRORS.BUTTON_URL_INVALID: Button {index} uses an invalid variable format.
ERRORS.BUTTON_URL_SINGLE_VARIABLE: Button {index} URL can contain at most one variable.
ERRORS.BUTTON_URL_SUFFIX: Button {index} URL variable must be the final suffix.
ERRORS.BUTTON_EXAMPLE_REQUIRED: Button {index} needs a sample suffix for review.
ERRORS.BUTTON_COPY_CODE_REQUIRED: Button {index} needs a sample coupon code.
ERRORS.BUTTON_COPY_CODE_LENGTH: Button {index} coupon code can be up to 15 characters.
ERRORS.BUTTON_PHONE_NUMBER_INVALID: Button {index} phone number must use E.164 format.
